group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03 (tool=LEGEND-research): 'Chang NS[au]' 138, 'Chang NS[au] AND WWOX' 66, 'Hsu LJ[au]' 103, 'Hsu LJ[au] AND WWOX' 30.
group_assessment.weighting: Five of the six papers in this group come from one laboratory lineage (Chang N-S / Hsu L-J, National Cheng Kung University). That laboratory originated WWOX and carries the gene's largest single output, so its measurements carry full weight; what it does NOT carry is independence. Two of its subjects are exclusive to it: 'Zfra NOT Chang NS[au]' returns 1 record and that record is an unrelated zebrafish androgen-receptor paper matching the string by accident; 'TIAF1 NOT Chang NS[au]' returns 5 of 20. The autophagy axis is the opposite case and is the reason this group is readable as a contradiction at all: 'WWOX AND autophagy' returns 10 records and 8 of them are from neither Chang NS nor Hsu LJ.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base is excluded from the public edition; this rests on measured PubMed counts and on the papers' own author lists.

field_density.note: WWOX/WOX1 is a named subject throughout, but the article is a narrative perspective: no experiment is performed in it.

multihop.enumeration_method: 51 <ref> elements, 52 PMIDs in the deposit. The mitochondrial statements this group was selected for all trace to one primary reference, which was identified by reading the citations in place rather than by resolving the whole list.

corpus_crossquery.query: Is PMID 21212468 carried anywhere in the registries, and is its ZFRA-versus-WWOX direction already asserted in LEGEND?
corpus_crossquery.finding: No registry record of any kind names PMID 21212468 (registry_records.py get exits 1). The 'Zfra counteracts WWOX' statement is therefore not carried, and if it is wanted it must enter through the primary it cites, not through this perspective.

verbatim_locators.note: Coverage: abstract, every section of the body, the single figure legend and the reference list. The one figure is a schematic and was inspected as an image. The article has no Methods, no Results and no supplement: it is a narrative perspective with one schematic, and every experimental statement in it is a citation to earlier primaries.

entries.proposition: THIS IS A SECONDARY SOURCE ON ITS CENTRAL MITOCHONDRIAL RESULT. The Bcl-2/Bcl-xL suppression, the absent cytochrome c release and the membrane-potential dissipation are all attributed to a prior primary; nothing is measured here. A datum carried from this paper is a datum carried from that primary.
entries.snippet: At the mitochondrial level, Zfra downregulates the expression of apoptosis inhibitor Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL
entries.anchor: 'Zfra executes mitochondrial apoptosis on its own manner', second paragraph

entries.proposition: THE MEMBRANE-POTENTIAL ENDPOINT IS STATED AS AN OVEREXPRESSION RESULT. It is a gain-of-function readout for Zfra, not a loss-of-function readout for WWOX, and it cannot be transferred to a WWOX-deficient genotype in either direction.
entries.snippet: Although Zfra may block cytochrome c release, overexpressed Zfra causes mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP) dissipation
entries.anchor: 'Zfra induces mitochondrial membrane potential dissipation', first sentence

entries.proposition: THE 'COUNTERACTS WWOX' RELATION IS AN INHIBITION OF A GAIN-OF-FUNCTION EFFECT, measured as blockade of the cytochrome c release that OVEREXPRESSED WOX1 produces. It says nothing about endogenous WWOX at physiological level, and the authors say so in the adjacent sentence about endogenous Zfra.
entries.snippet: For example, Zfra blocks WOX1-induced cytochrome c release
entries.anchor: 'Zfra controls p53- and WOX1-regulated mitochondrial apoptosis', second paragraph

entries.proposition: THE PAPER ITSELF MARKS THE ENDOGENOUS QUESTION AS OPEN. The whole Zfra-versus-WWOX hierarchy in this literature rests on overexpression, and this sentence is the authors' own statement of that limit.
entries.snippet: Whether the endogenous Zfra blocks the apoptotic function of p53 and WOX1 remains to be determined.
entries.anchor: 'A role of Zfra in the nucleus', final paragraph
